name: be-well-packed
description: Turn your plans for a trip, wedding or busy week into the moments you need outfits for, then dress them from your own Be Well Packed Closet.

interface.longDescription:
Paste your itinerary or tell Be Well Packed what’s ahead. It picks out the moments you’ll need an outfit for, like the flight, the rehearsal dinner or the day by the lake, with a few words on what to wear and the weather when there’s a forecast. Save it to Be Well Packed and dress each moment from your own Closet.

Connect your Be Well Packed account and it can style you from the clothes you’ve already saved: complete outfits from your own photos, for the occasion you describe. Add the one you like to your Closet or straight to a moment in your Plan.

Made for trips and weekends away, weddings and celebrations, and busy weeks with moments that matter. Connecting is optional for planning a trip. The plugin does not book flights, hotels or activities.
capabilities: Turn an itinerary into outfit moments
Save a trip to Be Well Packed
Style outfits from your saved Closet
Add an outfit to a moment in your Plan
Save new Looks to your Closet
defaultPrompt: Here’s my itinerary for Lisbon next week. What will I need outfits for?
I have a wedding weekend in Napa: rehearsal dinner, ceremony, brunch. Plan what I need to dress for.
Style my Friday dinner from my Be Well Packed Closet.

positive.prompt: Use Be Well Packed to plan what I need to wear. Two nights in Napa next weekend: Friday drive up and dinner at a winery, Saturday vineyard tour and a dressy dinner, Sunday brunch and drive home.
positive.expected_behavior: Check the weather, then show a short day-by-day list of about one or two outfit moments a day, each with a few words on what to wear. No invented clothing pieces. The reply is brief and does not repeat the list.

positive.description: Plan with clothing photos, then save
positive.prompt: Plan a two-night Napa trip next weekend with a casual day and a dinner, using these three pieces I own. Then save it to Be Well Packed.
positive.expected_behavior: Attach the three photographed pieces to the moments they suit, keep every photo, and on the explicit save request return the save link and explain that signing in on the website keeps the trip.

positive.prompt: Merge Saturday's lunch into the vineyard tour and make Sunday brunch more relaxed.
positive.expected_behavior: With an existing draft, keep its draftId and retained photoIds, and send the full revised trip.

positive.description: Style a Plan moment from the saved Closet
positive.prompt: Style the dinner in my Be Well Packed trip using clothes in my Closet, then add the one I pick.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the matching Plan and moment, inspect the actual saved clothes, and show complete Look cards that each offer Add to that moment. Save only the option the person chooses, keep its pieces and arrangement, and confirm only after the save succeeds. If the moment already has an outfit, ask before replacing it.

positive.description: Closet styling for an occasion, saved as a Look
positive.prompt: Give me four outfit options from my Closet for a tech conference, and save my favourite to my Closet.
positive.expected_behavior: Show all four options as complete actual-photo Look cards with working previous/next controls, without listing them again in text. Save only the chosen option, with its exact pieces and arrangement.

negative.prompt: Book and pay for flights to Paris.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Be Well Packed tools or claim a booking or payment. Explain that the plugin plans outfits and packing, and offer appropriate travel research separately.

negative.prompt: Read the clothes in my saved Closet without connecting my account.
negative.expected_behavior: Require account authorization for private Closet tools and return no private clothes or photos before authorization. Public trip planning from supplied clothes remains available without a connection.
Answer normally without invoking any Be Well Packed tools.

publication.release_notes: Rebuilt around two skills. Plan a trip turns an itinerary into the moments that need an outfit, with clothes optional and no invented pieces, shown as a short day-by-day list. Style my closet can now see a connected person's upcoming Plans and add a chosen outfit to one of its moments (new plans:read and plans:write scopes). Get started, Pack lighter, Plan outfits and Style your closet are replaced. Existing tool names are kept.
